purpose: Evaluate the already calibration-selected single-probe, source-image-normalized TRACE on complete official evaluation splits and matched allocation controls; never substitute older algorithm scores.
mode_selection: C was chosen using only the two128-image training calibration cells and sealed before confirmation. No mode, formula, parameter or score-definition changes are allowed in this stage.
order: Original complete official evaluation order, identical to the sealed inherited per-dataset protocol; no subset, shuffle or order search.
configuration: Copy the exact resolved config, checkpoint, vocabulary, full membership and order from the sealed A18 parent protocols, and final C4 VOC20 protocol. Do not resolve current BEST_CONFIGS as a replacement. No lr,steps,batch_size,K or preprocessing search.
method: Keep original candidates, source-image top-K, context perturbation, frozen diagnostic readout, detached candidate support, visual LayerNorm affine optimization and reconstruction. Compute exactly one context-perturbed diagnostic input per selected candidate; normalize region weights within each active source image, then average active images.
controls: Uniform and initial-confidence weights retain the same candidates, source-image normalization, optimizer, readout, input membership and order; no diagnostic view is computed for either control. Each arm executes independently after reset with identical initial RNG state; alternate arm execution order by episode.
gate: Before formal prediction, compare new worker C against direct ImageBalancedTRACE(view_mode=C) on four RGB-only inputs per dataset with the fixed support/loss1e-5 and zero changed-label-pixel tolerances. Check actual0/0/1 diagnostic schedules and finite losses; persistent exclusive attempt marker, no retry or OOM fallback.
prediction_barrier: Complete and seal all six datasets and all three arms before opening any evaluation label contents. Label stat metadata is allowed during input preparation; all scores are separate streaming CPU jobs after the global prediction barrier.
saved_evidence: Preserve full predictions and native candidate identities, regions, confidence, measured C, absent T as null, image/crop IDs, detached weight and objective coefficient for offline analysis. Do not fabricate unmeasured diagnostics.
cost: Actual forward/encoder inputs and batched calls; synchronized model-side timing with the established timing scope. Omit only episode0 from time, never from prediction, accuracy or work counts. Single-probe cost reduction is not a blanket wall-time guarantee.
runtime: New frozen source snapshot and exact six-manifest admission, single worker/shared GPU lock, deterministic default attention, systemd12GiB RAM/1GiB swap,RemainAfterExit=yes,OOMPolicy=stop,Restart=no. Fail closed on drift, nonfinite values, OOM or interruption; no automatic retries or overwrites.
exposure: These official evaluation splits and inherited per-dataset configurations have development exposure. This stage is a full-split evaluation of a fixed new variant, not a globally unseen or equal-tuning confirmation. Previous train confirmation also lacks exhaustive July4096 history certification.
statistics: Report seed0 full pooled class intersection/union mIoU and all contrasts, including zero or negative findings. No repeated deterministic seed runs, bootstrap, candidate-level independence, significance or confidence-interval claims.
comparison: MLMP values already reported in its paper remain cited reference operating points with explicit sources, never matched-environment claims. Do not rerun MLMP, WATT or CLIPArTT. Preserve available native COCO-CD references without retuning.
completion: Require all six gates, six canonical full results,18 rows, exact populations/order/arms/config/source bindings, global prediction-before-score barrier, pooled count/cost checks, whole SUITE_SEALED and genuine retained systemd successful terminal state before manuscript migration.
adoption: Assess the fixed C variant after all outcomes exist. Never switch to T,min or a per-dataset winner based on these evaluation results. If evidence does not justify replacing the current algorithm, preserve this variant and explicitly record the failed adoption; do not reuse older scores under its name.
bound: Only these six existing fast datasets, three arms and six gates. No automatic slow dataset, second backbone, ACDC, new dataset, parameter search, retry or further algorithm branch.
paper: Only after full completion integrate one unambiguous method identity, new tables, new real qualitative/diagnostic figures and complete exposure/cost scope. Archive prior paper and reviews. Then freeze a substantively revised manuscript for one fresh independent reviewer without target or previous score disclosure. A new run or manuscript is not an acceptance claim.
